evidence_policy: Declarations are signatures/fields only. Findings explicitly include selected decoded native instructions. Inferences and original proposals are separate. No playable proof.

findings.claim: Native constructor establishes first-person movement controls, not an idle simulation.
findings.readback: walkSpeed at0x38 defaults6, jumpForce at0x50 defaults8, gravity at0x54 defaults30; serialized scene values can override these.
findings.limits_and_inference: Scene puzzle and obstacle lens; no native platforming behavior was played.

findings.claim: Level-one completion coroutine awards completion currency separately from completion count.
findings.readback: FinishedLevels is set to1 only when its integer stat is0; ASCENSIONS float receives+1 when Steam initialized and GetStat succeeds.
findings.limits_and_inference: No prestige/reset demonstrated. This is code presence, not a Steam-account stat read.

findings.claim: Supplies have distinct currency prices and stock quantities.
findings.readback: RequireASCENSIONS>=1, subtract1, StoreStats; then GetStat PillowAmount and add100. Drink costs3 adds18; AC costs4 adds35; IE costs5 adds25, anchored separately in retained method index.
findings.limits_and_inference: Supplies, not demonstrated permanent stat upgrades. Their runtime effect magnitudes were not recovered.

findings.claim: Fuse check distinguishes missing requirement, success and repeat success.
findings.readback: HasItem0x50 false activatesNeedFuse0x20; true plus ONCE0x52 false latches it, activatesSuccess, changes terminal state and plays door animation.
findings.limits_and_inference: Requirement feedback and exactly-once presentation are useful for native YAIR encounters; fuse acquisition not traced.

findings.claim: Weight gate counts distinct object categories and acknowledges completion.
findings.readback: Weight0x20 approaches targetMaxWeight0x28 by WeightFade0x24*deltaTime; updates text when difference>0.01; threshold10.7 flipsStillIntact0x70 false and opens door; false state shows rewarded.
findings.limits_and_inference: MaxWeight is a misleading field name: selected trigger bodies add contributions to it. This is a >=threshold, not an exact-weight puzzle.

findings.claim: Category contributions are guarded and removable.
findings.readback: P1 adds1, P2 adds2, Weapon1.5, Obj1 2.8, Obj2 2.3, Obj3 0.9, Obj4 0.2, each gated by its boolean. RevDumb1 subtracts1 and clearsDumb1. OnTriggerExit/other removal bodies remain declaration-only.
findings.limits_and_inference: Weighted item semantics can be original YAIR recipe requirements without importing physics.

findings.claim: Heat warning and failure use separate time thresholds.
findings.readback: Timer0x20 incrementsdeltaTime; above330 andReadyT0x38 showsText and clears guard; above serializedMax0x24 activatesHeat and callsDying.StartDying.
findings.limits_and_inference: Actual sceneMax not acquired; warning ordering relative to scene failure is not verified.

findings.claim: Hydration presents early warning and a one-use refill.
findings.readback: UI displaysAmount0x40, Warning active below0.2, Amount-=Faderspeed0x44*deltaTime. KeyDown0x72 with active bottle andHasWater resetsAmount1 and clearsHasWater.
findings.limits_and_inference: No damage or thirst death is demonstrated in this method; do not add that as a source claim.

findings.claim: Elevator action differentiates selection, prerequisite and completion.
findings.readback: Three active slide objects choose separate branches; third checksExtractorThere and callsRay8.ENeedText if absent; CanDo guards activation; OPEN andACTIVE status updates accompany animation/audio calls.
findings.limits_and_inference: Adapt to a location action with plain statuses; exact puzzle sequence and scene bindings remain unknown.

findings.claim: A collective achievement requires all six completion flags and a latch.
findings.readback: Checks six RoboLVL8.DidMake at0x98 thenAction0x50; setsAction before Steam initialized branch and setsALL6 achievement only with Steam.
findings.limits_and_inference: Aggregate condition is demonstrated; achievement may be missed if Steam unavailable at latch time. Do not replicate external-service authority.

findings.claim: Boss health is an arithmetic variable with hit feedback.
findings.readback: Health0xC0-=HealthDamage0xC4 then instantiatesEffectTake. Constructor defaults1.0 health and0.1 damage; scene overrides unacquired.
findings.limits_and_inference: Boss telegraph/timing field declarations exist but their full behavior was not recovered; no claim of ten-hit playable balance.

findings.claim: Retry reloads a named scene, while spawn setup can vary.
findings.readback: Key polling invokesSceneManager.LoadScene usingSceneName0x20. ManagerSpawn.Start randomizes0..Spawns.Length then activates selected member.
findings.limits_and_inference: No mid-scene saved checkpoint established. Do not label random spawning as procedural generation or give retry retention assumptions.

ranked_original_proposals.title: Visible repair gate
ranked_original_proposals.proposal: A single optional Nearby cave mechanism asks for an ordinary component, shows missing/supplied/ready and pays once.
ranked_original_proposals.implementation_boundary: Native location action plus inventory transaction; optional sparse encounter state.
ranked_original_proposals.acceptance_gate: Missing item rejects without mutation; proper item resolves once; repeat click, reload and import never duplicate reward.

ranked_original_proposals.title: Weighted contribution puzzle
ranked_original_proposals.proposal: One cave counterweight accepts several original item categories; show contribution and remaining requirement before placement.
ranked_original_proposals.implementation_boundary: Reuse component counts and ordinary Weightlifting access, not physics or another XP pool.
ranked_original_proposals.acceptance_gate: Distinct category placement cannot double count; removing restores state; threshold crossing pays once; old saves have no invented placements.

ranked_original_proposals.title: Encounter retry with recovery
ranked_original_proposals.proposal: An optional challenge has a retry that explains exactly what resets; native unconsciousness/recovery remains the defeat rule.
ranked_original_proposals.implementation_boundary: Encounter-local transient state with an explicit compatible retention policy.
ranked_original_proposals.acceptance_gate: Leaving/retrying cannot refund spent rewards or reroll a committed outcome; native defeat unchanged; save/reload/import honors declared scope.

ranked_original_proposals.title: Preparation instead of permanent upgrades
ranked_original_proposals.proposal: Offer one supply choice for the next optional outing using existing item stock and merchant prices.
ranked_original_proposals.implementation_boundary: Native coins and inventory; no ASCENSIONS currency, achievement dependence or prestige reset.
ranked_original_proposals.acceptance_gate: Purchase atomically debits coins and adds item; insufficient funds/full rejection changes neither; effects only through ordinary item use.

ranked_original_proposals.title: Readable hazard and refuge
ranked_original_proposals.proposal: For one proposed heat exposure encounter, show warning and remaining safe time and let player retreat.
ranked_original_proposals.implementation_boundary: Bounded native location effect; skill mitigation through existing location rules.
ranked_original_proposals.acceptance_gate: Warnings readable before failure; pausing/leaving rules explicit; save/reload/import preserve elapsed state without wall-clock surprise.

ranked_original_proposals.title: Prerequisite-aware action wording
ranked_original_proposals.proposal: Replace a generic blocked encounter action with the specific missing tool and the next useful center action.
ranked_original_proposals.implementation_boundary: Existing center/location menu; no modal dashboard.
ranked_original_proposals.acceptance_gate: Blocked command refuses safely and says why; obtaining requirement changes label; already completed state remains readable.

ranked_original_proposals.title: Personal completion record
ranked_original_proposals.proposal: Record first clear separately from repeat performance, making an ordinary task part of biography.
ranked_original_proposals.implementation_boundary: Native event plus deduplicated life milestone; optional personal best.
ranked_original_proposals.acceptance_gate: First clear writes one event, repeats improve only valid best; fresh/legacy/reload/import do not invent or duplicate deeds.

ranked_original_proposals.title: Collective work checklist
ranked_original_proposals.proposal: One location errand displays several concrete prerequisite tasks and pays when all finish.
ranked_original_proposals.implementation_boundary: Native quest conditions and center actions, not six new currencies.
ranked_original_proposals.acceptance_gate: Order independent checks; remaining tasks listed; completion latches only after local reward succeeds; offline/local play identical.
